level_one.title: Winter's Reach
level_one.description: Increase the range and travel speed of Frostbolt by 30%.

level_four.title: Arcane Intellect
level_four.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

level_seven.title: Ice Lance
level_seven.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

level_ten.title: Ring of Frost
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

level_thirteen.title: Icy Veins
level_thirteen.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Numbing Blast
level_sixteen.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 0.75 seconds.

level_one.title: Simple Geometry
level_one.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

level_four.title: Serrated Arrows
level_four.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_seven.title: Never Outmatched
level_seven.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragon's Arrow
level_ten.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Fleet of Foot
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

level_sixteen.title: Piercing Arrows
level_sixteen.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

level_one.title: Soul Shield
level_one.description: Activate to gain 25 plus 50% of Diablo's current Souls as Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Every time Diablo damages an enemy Hero, reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

level_four.title: Life Leech
level_four.description: Diablo gains 1 Soul and heals for 1.75% of his maximum Health when Basic Attacking an enemy Hero. While at 100 Souls, increase this healing to 3.5% of his maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Malevolence
level_seven.description: Basic Abilities cause Diablo's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 100 (+4% per level) Spell Damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

level_ten.title: Apocalypse
level_ten.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Cruelty
level_thirteen.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower increases Diablo's Attack Speed by 50% for 7 seconds, up to 100%.

level_sixteen.title: Overpowering Nightmare
level_sixteen.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Overpower, with a 2 second cooldown between uses.

level_one.title: Inquisitor's Prayer
level_one.description: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Intercession
level_seven.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Lashing Out
level_thirteen.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Harsh Discipline
level_sixteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Amateur Opponent
level_one.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

level_four.title: Shield Battery
level_four.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active.  Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Final Cut
level_seven.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

level_ten.title: Suppression Pulse
level_ten.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

level_thirteen.title: Triple Strike
level_thirteen.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Force of Will
level_sixteen.description: Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.

level_one.title: Evenhanded Blessings
level_one.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Binding Heal
level_seven.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Speed of the Pious
level_thirteen.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Renew
level_sixteen.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

level_twenty.title: Censure
level_twenty.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Viciousness
level_one.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

level_seven.title: Quicksilver Bullets
level_seven.description: Increases Greymane's Human Basic Attack range by 1.1.

level_thirteen.title: On the Prowl
level_thirteen.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Eager Wolf
level_sixteen.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Inner Beast by an additional 40% after it has been active for 4 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Hunter's Blunderbuss
level_twenty.description: Human Basic Attacks splash for 100% damage behind the target.

level_one.title: Laws of Hope
level_one.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.  Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Steed Charge
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly Mount for 4 seconds, unhindered by damage.  Passive: Increase the duration of Iron Skin by 2 second.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Roar
level_thirteen.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Blessed Momentum
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks grant 10% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40%. They also reduce Johanna's Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Blinded By The Light
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.  Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.

level_one.title: Spy Games
level_one.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

level_four.title: Erik the Swift
level_four.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_seven.title: Spin To Win!
level_seven.description: Activate to have each Viking deal 85 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

level_ten.title: Longboat Raid!
level_ten.description: Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.  Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Jump!
level_thirteen.description: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: 64 KB Marathon
level_sixteen.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

level_twenty.title: Ragnarok 'n' Roll!
level_twenty.description: The Longboat can attack two targets at once and the range of its Mortar is increased by 100%. Reduce Longboat Raid!'s cooldown by 30 seconds.

level_one.title: Aether Walker
level_one.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level_four.title: Dominance
level_four.description: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

level_seven.title: Seeker
level_seven.description: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.

level_ten.title: Wave Of Force
level_ten.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Mirrorball
level_sixteen.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

level_twenty.title: Repulsion
level_twenty.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.
